transformations.reason: Set the existing HTML date field through its native value property; keyboard character insertion is not a date-input filling API. This affects only the later reminder setup after the baseline's missing-field assertion.

transformations.added_assertion: All observed page and Worker network requests must be GET on the local origin.
transformations.reason: Chrome Worker targets support Network.enable, but not Fetch.enable; preserve the browser sandbox and actual Worker instead of suppressing the protocol error.

transformations.old:
assert.ok(report.requests.every(request=>request.method==='GET'&&new URL(request.url).origin===base),
  'all observed page and Worker network requests stay on the local receiving origin');
transformations.reason: The current native HTML date input emits one inline data:image/svg+xml calendar icon. It has no HTTP origin and makes no network request; actual HTTP(S) requests remain constrained to the local origin.
